poster_title: TAKE A STEP BACK: EVOKING REASONING VIA ABSTRACTION IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
authors: Huaixiu Steven Zheng, Swaroop Mishra, Xinyun Chen, Heng-Tze Cheng, Ed H. Chi, Quoc V Le, Denny Zhou

content: Transformers and large language models (LLMs) have advanced NLP capabilities.
Scaling model size and data improves performance and efficiency.
LLMs show emergent abilities like multi-step reasoning and instruction following.
However, complex reasoning remains challenging with frequent intermediate errors.
STEP-BACK PROMPTING: a two-step process of Abstraction and Reasoning.
Abstraction: derive high-level concepts from the original question.
Reasoning: use high-level concepts to guide the reasoning process.
Evaluated on PaLM-2L, GPT-4, and Llama2-70B models.
Tasks: MMLU Physics and Chemistry, GSM8K, TimeQA, MuSiQue.
panels.figure_caption: Performance of STEP-BACK PROMPTING across various reasoning tasks.

content: Improved PaLM-2L on MMLU Physics by 7% and Chemistry by 11%.
Significant improvements on complex reasoning tasks.
Reasoning errors dominate in MMLU high-school Physics.
STEP-BACK + RAG fixes 39.9% of baseline errors on TimeQA.
STEP-BACK + RAG introduces 5.6% new errors on TimeQA.
panels.figure_caption: Error analysis of STEP-BACK PROMPTING on MMLU high-school Physics.

content: STEP-BACK PROMPTING reduces reasoning errors by grounding on high-level abstractions.
Promising for improving LLM performance on complex reasoning tasks.
Future work: enhance reasoning capabilities while maintaining abstraction skills.

Fig1.caption: Figure 1: Strong Performance of STEP-BACK PROMPTING: our proposed Abstraction-and-Reasoning scheme leads to a substantial improvement in a wide range of challenging tasks in STEM, Knowledge QA and Multi-Hop Reasoning requiring complex (often multi-hop) reasoning.
Fig1.description: 展示 STEP-BACK PROMPTING 在多个复杂任务中的显著性能提升，包括 STEM、知识问答和多步推理任务。

Fig2.caption: Figure 4: Error Analysis of STEP-BACK PROMPTING on MMLU high-school Physics: five classes of errors Step-Back makes with Reasoning being the dominating class.
Fig2.description: 分析 STEP-BACK PROMPTING 在 MMLU 高中物理任务中的错误类型，推理错误是主要类别。
